title: Gestalt Configuration
description: Configuration file for Gestalt AI Development Harness

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion

standard.description: Standard tier — general-purpose tasks (interview, spec generation)

frontier.description: Frontier tier — complex reasoning tasks (architecture, code review)

resolutionThreshold.description: Resolution threshold above which requirements are considered clear (env: GESTALT_RESOLUTION_THRESHOLD)

maxRounds.description: Maximum number of interview rounds (env: GESTALT_MAX_ROUNDS)

reasoningModel.description: Agent subagent model for deep one-shot reasoning in spec generation and execution planning (env: GESTALT_REASONING_MODEL)

reasoningModelFallback.description: Fallback model when the Agent tool does not support reasoningModel (env: GESTALT_REASONING_MODEL_FALLBACK)

dbPath.description: Path to the SQLite event store database (env: GESTALT_DB_PATH)

ruleSources.description: Rule sources outside this repo that skills must read before producing work — declared per repo so Gestalt itself stays organization-agnostic. Only declared sources are read; Gestalt never scans attached MCP servers to pick one

ruleSourceErrors.description: Filled by Gestalt, not by the author. Non-empty means ruleSources was declared but could not be parsed, so ruleSources fell back to empty — skills must not read that empty array as 'nothing declared'

notifications.description: Enable OS desktop notifications for pipeline events (env: GESTALT_NOTIFICATIONS)

client.description: MCP client type — controls where active session context is written. 'claude-code' writes to .claude/rules/, 'codex' writes to AGENTS.md, 'grok' writes to .grok/rules/, 'both' writes to Claude and Codex only (env: GESTALT_CLIENT)

apiKey.description: API key for this tier (falls back to llm.apiKey if omitted)

baseURL.description: Base URL for the API (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama)

ruleSource.description: A standard neither Gestalt nor the target repo owns — design tokens, org conventions, product principles. See plugin/skills/_shared/rule-sources.md

id.description: Name used in reporting. Must be unique within this config

kind.description: Where the rule lives — an MCP tool, a file path, or another skill that owns the task

ref.description: Target for the given kind — MCP tool name, repo-relative file path, or skill name. A file ref must stay inside the repo: absolute paths and .. are rejected

scope.description: Read this source only for tasks tagged with one of these. Tags come from the files the task touches (ui, css, api, db, docs, test), not from the request wording. Empty means always read

trust.description: 'convention' follows the format it defines (token names, naming, required fields). 'delegate' hands the task to it instead and requires kind: skill. Neither lets the source widen the scope of work

onMissing.description: When the source cannot be read. 'skip' proceeds silently, 'warn' proceeds and records the gap in the completion report, 'stop' halts and explains what would unblock it
